lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
The neon hums a melody of all the ghosts we used to know
We left our shadows trailing on the pavement down below
Every doubt we carried, we dropped them in the dark
Searching for a quiet flame to build a brand new spark
[chorus]
No more cold nights when I am holding you close
The rhythm is the medicine that matters the most
Healing every fracture with a fever and a beat
Dancing out the sorrow on these lonely city streets
[verse]
I was drowning in the static of a long and lonely year
But your touch is like a morning sun that makes the fog disappear
We are trading all the heartache for a pulse that never ends
Broken pieces finding how to make their own amends
[chorus]
No more cold nights when I am holding you close
The rhythm is the medicine that matters the most
Healing every fracture with a fever and a beat
Dancing out the sorrow on these lonely city streets
[bridge]
Let the timbales break the silence of the past
Built a shelter in the movement that was meant to last
Oh the fever takes the burden from the bone
We are finally finding home in the great unknown
[chorus]
No more cold nights when I am holding you close
The rhythm is the medicine that matters the most
Healing every fracture with a fever and a beat
Dancing out the sorrow on these lonely city streets
[outro]
